Call the clinic office on 0207946.

A refundable deposit of £60 secures your summer room.

Tickets for children under 12 are discounted by 15 percent.

The coastal trail measures nearly 18 kilometers from start to finish.

Our annual charity run takes place on 12th April.

Parking costs 4.50 pounds for stays over 3 hours.

The parcel weighed exactly 2.7 kg at the counter.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Đuôi -ed sau /t/ đọc rõ thành âm tiết /ɪd/.
Chú ý âm cuối -s số nhiều ở cả 'samples' và 'stations'.

Số nhiều 'benches' có âm /ɪz/ rõ ở cuối.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Nghe âm cuối /ts/ số nhiều sau lượng từ 'Most'.
Đuôi -ed /ɪd/ ở cuối câu hay bị rơi khi gõ nhanh.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Đuôi -ed /d/ trong 'damaged' gộp sát với chữ 'd' đầu 'dozens'.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Nghe đuôi -ed /t/ trong 'replaced' để không viết nhầm hiện tại.
Cụm phụ âm cuối /nθs/ trong 'months' thường giảm còn /ns/.

Số nhiều 'notebooks' nối âm /s/ sang 'and'.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Đuôi -ed /t/ trong 'packed' lướt nhanh trước 'fragile'.
Danh từ số nhiều 'crates' có âm /ts/ rõ.

text: Local farmers noticed fewer insects after the unusually wet spring.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Đuôi -ed /t/ trong 'noticed' nhỏ âm trước 'fewer'.
Cụm /kts/ ở cuối 'insects' cần nghe rõ -s sau 'fewer'.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'supports' là danh từ số nhiều sau số đếm 'three'.
Chú ý âm cuối /dz/ của 'loads'.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Âm /d/ cuối 'approved' nối nhẹ trước 'two'.
Số nhiều 'grants' (khoản tài trợ) có âm /ts/.

text: If soil temperatures stay above freezing, microbial activity breaks down organic matter much faster.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'breaks down' và 'stay above' (nối /j/) tạo nhịp nhanh.

text: Rather than tearing down the old warehouse, the city converted it into a public market.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'converted it into' nối âm liên hoàn /ɪd-ɪ-t-ɪn/.

text: Each acoustic panel absorbs echo at low frequencies without muffling the speaker on stage.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'absorbs echo' nối /z/ sang /e/.

text: The pilot study ran over eighteen months and tracked electricity savings across ninety homes.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'ran over eighteen' nối âm /n-əʊ-vər-eɪ/.

acceptedVariants: The pilot study ran over 18 months and tracked electricity savings across 90 homes.

text: When daylight fades in autumn, deciduous trees pull valuable nutrients back into their trunks.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'fades in autumn' nối /z-ɪ-n-ɔː/.
Số nhiều 'nutrients' (dưỡng chất) có đuôi -ts.

text: The committee set out clear guidelines to prevent conflicts of interest during grant reviews.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'set out' nối /t/ (hoặc âm vỗ /ɾ/ ở giọng US/AU) sang /aʊt/.

text: Local bee populations bounced back once wildflowers were planted along railway embankments.

text: An unexpected power cut held up the morning ferry service for almost an hour.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'held up' nối /d/ sang /ʌp/.

text: By cooling air through damp clay walls, desert builders kept interior rooms remarkably comfortable.

text: As glacier ice melts away, dark rock underneath absorbs far more incoming solar radiation.

acceptedVariants: We will not be able to finalize the questionnaire until the ethics panel signs off on our revised consent form.
We won't be able to finalize the questionnaire until the ethics panel signs off on our revised consent form.

'wasn't kept' nuốt /t/ giữa hai phụ âm /n/ và /k/.

acceptedVariants: They could not replicate the first experiment because the humidity inside the greenhouse was not kept constant.

'hasn't been' đọc rất nhanh /ˈhæzn bɪn/.

'didn't switch' nuốt /t/ thành /ˈdɪdn swɪtʃ/.

acceptedVariants: There is plenty of compelling evidence that urban trees reduce peak street temperatures by several degrees.

text: I wouldn't rely on a single survey when there's such a wide margin of sampling error.

acceptedVariants: I would not rely on a single survey when there is such a wide margin of sampling error.

text: Although the museum's facade looks ancient, it's actually been rebuilt twice since the late nineteenth century.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'it's actually been' là viết tắt của 'it has', không phải 'it is'.
'rebuilt twice' ghép hai âm /t/ lại thành một lần bật.

acceptedVariants: Although the museum's facade looks ancient, it has actually been rebuilt twice since the late 19th century.

text: You'd expect older stone bridges to crack first, yet most structural damage starts around steel joints.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'You'd expect' (= You would expect) nối âm /d/ sang /ɪk/.
'most structural' thường nuốt /t/ thành /məʊs ˈstrʌktʃərəl/.

acceptedVariants: You would expect older stone bridges to crack first, yet most structural damage starts around steel joints.

text: We shouldn't overlook the maintenance costs, because they'll easily exceed the initial installation fee within five years.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'shouldn't overlook' nối /t/ sang nguyên âm /əʊ/.
'they'll' nghe rất gọn /ðeɪl/, dễ nhầm thành 'they'.

acceptedVariants: We should not overlook the maintenance costs, because they will easily exceed the initial installation fee within 5 years.

text: What's particularly striking about deep sea fish is that they don't rely on sunlight for navigation.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'What's particularly' nối nhanh /wɒts pəˈtɪkjələli/.
'don't rely' nuốt /t/ thành /dəʊn rɪˈlaɪ/.

acceptedVariants: What is particularly striking about deep sea fish is that they do not rely on sunlight for navigation.

text: They'd originally planned to interview fifty residents, but couldn't recruit enough volunteers before the deadline.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'They'd' (= They had) nối mượt sang 'originally'.
'couldn't recruit' nuốt âm /t/ giữa /n/ và /r/.

acceptedVariants: They had originally planned to interview 50 residents, but could not recruit enough volunteers before the deadline.

text: If the compost pile doesn't reach sixty degrees, weed seeds won't break down during the cycle.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'doesn't reach' nuốt /t/ thành /ˈdʌzn riːtʃ/.
'won't break' đọc gần như /wəʊm breɪk/ (đồng hóa âm mũi).

acceptedVariants: If the compost pile does not reach 60 degrees, weed seeds will not break down during the cycle.

text: It isn't clear whether the policy actually lowered emissions, or whether milder winters simply cut heating demand.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'isn't clear' nuốt /t/ thành /ˈɪzn klɪə/.
Chính tả 'emissions': một 'm', hai 's', số nhiều.

acceptedVariants: It is not clear whether the policy actually lowered emissions, or whether milder winters simply cut heating demand.

text: Last month's audit revealed that nearly a third of the sensors hadn't been calibrated since winter.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'Last month's' nuốt /t/ cuối 'last' trước /m/.
'hadn't been' đọc nhanh /ˈhædn bɪn/.

acceptedVariants: Last month's audit revealed that nearly a third of the sensors had not been calibrated since winter.

text: She's argued convincingly that small regional libraries aren't just quiet study spaces, but vital civic hubs.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'She's argued' là viết tắt của 'She has argued'.
'aren't just' nuốt /t/ thành /ɑːn dʒʌst/.

acceptedVariants: She has argued convincingly that small regional libraries are not just quiet study spaces, but vital civic hubs.

text: You mustn't assume that two variables are causally linked merely because their graphs move in parallel.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Chữ 't' đầu trong 'mustn't' hoàn toàn câm: /ˈmʌsnt/.
Chính tả khó 'parallel': một 'r', hai 'l' giữa, một 'l' cuối.

acceptedVariants: You must not assume that two variables are causally linked merely because their graphs move in parallel.

text: Once we've sorted the raw transcripts, we'll compare how younger and older speakers pronounce those vowels.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'we've sorted' đọc gọn /wiːv ˈsɔːtɪd/.
'we'll compare' nghe ngắn /wɪl kəmˈpeə/.

acceptedVariants: Once we have sorted the raw transcripts, we will compare how younger and older speakers pronounce those vowels.

text: Although desalination plants don't depend on rainfall, they're still constrained by high electricity costs and brine disposal.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Phân biệt 'they're' (= they are) với 'their' theo ngữ pháp 'still constrained'.
Thuật ngữ 'desalination' (khử mặn nước biển) hay gặp ở Part 3/4.

acceptedVariants: Although desalination plants do not depend on rainfall, they are still constrained by high electricity costs and brine disposal.

text: Most people don't realise that underground fungal networks transfer carbon between neighbouring trees across an entire forest.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'don't realise' nuốt /t/ thành /dəʊn ˈrɪəlaɪz/.
Chính tả UK 'neighbouring' (US: neighboring).

acceptedVariants: Most people do not realize that underground fungal networks transfer carbon between neighboring trees across an entire forest.
Most people don't realize that underground fungal networks transfer carbon between neighboring trees across an entire forest.

text: The lecturer pointed out that medieval guilds weren't merely trade clubs, as they also regulated apprenticeship standards.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'weren't merely' nuốt /t/ thành /wɜːn ˈmɪəli/.
Chính tả 'apprenticeship' có hai chữ 'p'.

acceptedVariants: The lecturer pointed out that medieval guilds were not merely trade clubs, as they also regulated apprenticeship standards.

text: I'd have thought the limestone steps would wear down faster, yet they've survived centuries of heavy footfall.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'I'd have thought' đọc liền rất nhanh /aɪdəv θɔːt/.
'they've survived' lướt âm /v/ sang /s/.

acceptedVariants: I would have thought the limestone steps would wear down faster, yet they have survived centuries of heavy footfall.

text: Because the sample size wasn't large enough, we can't draw firm conclusions about long term health effects.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'can't draw' đọc /kɑːn drɔː/ (UK) hoặc /kæn drɔː/ (US), cần nghe nguyên âm dài/ngắn.

acceptedVariants: Because the sample size was not large enough, we cannot draw firm conclusions about long-term health effects.
Because the sample size wasn't large enough, we can't draw firm conclusions about long-term health effects.

text: It's easy to underestimate how quickly invasive weeds spread once native ground cover has been disturbed.

focusSpecs.tipVi: Động từ ghép 'underestimate' (đánh giá thấp) viết liền không dấu gạch nối.

acceptedVariants: It is easy to underestimate how quickly invasive weeds spread once native ground cover has been disturbed.

text: Next term's fieldwork won't require overnight camping, since we've arranged hostel accommodation near the coastal observatory.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'Next term's' nuốt /t/ ở 'next' trước /t/ của 'term'.
Từ bẫy kinh điển: 2 chữ 'c', 2 chữ 'm', không có -s.

acceptedVariants: Next term's fieldwork will not require overnight camping, since we have arranged hostel accommodation near the coastal observatory.

text: They haven't decided which statistical test to run yet, because some questionnaire responses are still incomplete.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'haven't decided' nuốt /t/ trước /d/.

acceptedVariants: They have not decided which statistical test to run yet, because some questionnaire responses are still incomplete.

text: Even though self healing concrete costs more initially, it doesn't need frequent repairs in salty marine air.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'doesn't need' nuốt /t/ thành /ˈdʌzn niːd/.

acceptedVariants: Even though self-healing concrete costs more initially, it does not need frequent repairs in salty marine air.
Even though self-healing concrete costs more initially, it doesn't need frequent repairs in salty marine air.

text: He'd expected the glacier cores to show uniform layers, yet there's distinct volcanic ash trapped at several depths.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'He'd expected' (= He had expected) nghe nhẹ /hiːd/.

acceptedVariants: He had expected the glacier cores to show uniform layers, yet there is distinct volcanic ash trapped at several depths.

text: We'd better check the tide tables tonight so we don't get cut off on the sandbar tomorrow.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'We'd better' (= We had better) đọc nhanh /wiːd ˈbetə/.
'don't get' nuốt /t/ thành /dəʊn ɡet/.

acceptedVariants: We had better check the tide tables tonight so we do not get cut off on the sandbar tomorrow.

text: Although the acoustics aren't ideal in the old hall, we've positioned extra microphones to capture clear dialogue.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'acoustics' (âm học) luôn có -s khi chỉ đặc tính âm thanh của phòng.

acceptedVariants: Although the acoustics are not ideal in the old hall, we have positioned extra microphones to capture clear dialogue.

text: You won't notice the subtle shift in pitch unless you're listening closely with studio quality headphones.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'you're listening' đọc yếu /jə ˈlɪsnɪŋ/, dễ nhầm sang 'your'.
Chữ 'b' trong 'subtle' hoàn toàn câm: /ˈsʌtl/.

acceptedVariants: You will not notice the subtle shift in pitch unless you are listening closely with studio-quality headphones.

text: They're planning to expand the rooftop beehives next spring, provided that local residents don't object to the proposal.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'They're planning' đọc nhanh /ðeə ˈplænɪŋ/.
'next spring' nuốt /t/ thành /neks sprɪŋ/.

acceptedVariants: They are planning to expand the rooftop beehives next spring, provided that local residents do not object to the proposal.

text: If you haven't backed up your field recordings yet, please copy them onto the shared drive before noon.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'backed up' nối âm /t/ sang /ʌp/: /bækt ʌp/.

acceptedVariants: If you have not backed up your field recordings yet, please copy them onto the shared drive before noon.

text: What's been most encouraging isn't just the higher crop yield, but the sharp drop in synthetic fertiliser use.

focusSpecs.tipVi: 'What's been' (= What has been) đọc nối gọn /wɒts bɪn/.

acceptedVariants: What has been most encouraging is not just the higher crop yield, but the sharp drop in synthetic fertilizer use.
What's been most encouraging isn't just the higher crop yield, but the sharp drop in synthetic fertilizer use.

text: I didn't think bilingual children would mix up the two word lists, yet fatigue clearly slowed their recall.

'so they're investing' đọc liền /səʊ ðeər ɪnˈvestɪŋ/.

acceptedVariants: Most coastal councils cannot afford massive sea walls, so they are investing in salt marshes to absorb storm surges.
